notes: Coverage: every text block, every inline formula, and the complete displayed exact sequence was read from the images against BOTH C and H, including readings on which they agree. This coverage statement is not a mathematical proof check. All C alerts were considered: E/E-prime, H/i, both degree 2 marks, star/Ext, the upper brace/P, sigma/Hom/lower 2, all quotation spans, the heavy N, both epithets, and every lexical/cancellation doubt.

Workflow: the whole scan was opened exactly once for layout, then half_a exactly once, then half_b exactly once. Sixteen tight crops were generated after those passes and each was inspected once. No whole/half was reopened, no settled locus was recropped, and no OCR, recognition software, PDF text layer, outside source, other scan, or other reader return was used. Crop boxes are expressed in pixels of the whole 1139×1739 source image.

The page is entirely handwritten and continues a letter. No new heading, date, salutation, signature, author page number, page-total statement, independent diagram, independent drawing, or margin note is visible on this sheet. The archive pencil 9 is recorded only as a comment; H page{9} is credited as the same metadata and is not counted as an omission.

The page says that E-prime has invariants given by those of E in degree i+2 and writes an exact sequence in degree 2 with P(M,N) as the brace label of the middle term. It then labels its interpretation Heuristiquement and explicitly assumes that the theory for strict 1-champs extends to strict 2-champs, adding ce qui pour moi ne fait guère de doute. These are source statements, not results independently proved in this run.

The last paragraph says that the exact sequence is constructed en tous cas canoniquement, quotes à la main, and begins describing the middle sheaf before the sheet breaks off after près des. No completion from another sheet has been supplied.

The two substantive interlinear additions in the middle paragraph are credited to H because its note explicitly identifies them. Their insertion connectors are represented by inserted macros at their attachment points, not as separate figures. The last raised à has its own connector before the cancelled form; it is placed at that observed attachment.

Readings settled from halves without a reader crop have explicit adjudication_source/adjudication_box metadata in their changes rows. The opening pair before 2-champ also has an uncropped_evidence_box because c03 covers only the lower portion of that quotation span. Those boxes are retained observations for the main reader, not measurements from a reopened image.

The tiny point above the right side of the cancelled article is physically distinct in c11, but its textual status and layer attachment remain open. The reading places it above the shared e region using overset and retains a no-independent-character alternative. Other faint reverse-side show-through and dispersed background specks are not treated as current-face writing.

The first captured UTC timestamp was taken after the preparatory packet reading. The model identity is the one supplied in the inherited instructions; no reasoning-effort setting is exposed. No mathematical theorem, construction, exactness claim, or interpretation was independently proved or computed here, so math_checks is empty.
